title: Blackfathom Deeps
body: Blackfathom Deeps opens at the northern end of the Zoram Strand, where Ashenvale meets the sea. It was once a temple of Elune, until the Sundering shattered it and sank it beneath the waves. For ages its drowned halls lay undisturbed, until the naga and the satyrs came, drawn by its ancient power. Murlocs crowd the halls nearest the entrance, naga hold the great pools beyond, and deeper in the Twilight's Hammer has gathered, crying that Aku'mai demands more sacrifices.

parts.body: The Argent Dawn has heard that the Twilight's Hammer and the naga have joined forces in the old temple, and the scout it sent to learn more has not come back.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Blackfathom_Deeps_(Classic) (partially underwater dungeon in northwestern Ashenvale; temple of Elune sunk beneath the Veiled Sea by the Great Sundering, untouched until the naga and satyrs found it; the Twilight's Hammer guards Aku'mai, a pet of the Old Gods); the pre-Cataclysm official description (legends hold the ancient beast Aku'mai, a favored pet of the Old Gods, has taken up residence in the temple's ruins; the Twilight's Hammer drawn to its presence)

parts.body: The naga harvest sapphire crystals from the walls of the first tunnels. The spirits of water cling to them, and the cult's aquamancers use them in their summonings.

parts.body: A cultist named Lorgus Jett means to use the crystals to appease Aku'mai and bring it back, and with it an era of rule by the Old Gods.

title: The Pool of Ask'ar
body: The Pool of Ask'ar is the first great flooded hall of the deeps, a wide basin of dark water beyond the murlocs' passages. Naga sea witches and myrmidons keep watch around it, a great sea turtle swims in it, and off its shore a naga called Lady Sarevess holds a side cavern. Past it lies an old shrine where the murloc Gelihast keeps his tribe.

title: The Moonshrine Ruins
body: Deep within the flooded temple lie the Moonshrine Ruins, the broken remains of a shrine of the moon, half drowned in dark water. The Twilight's Hammer has made its camp among them. Its aquamancers keep elementals of living water at their sides, and its cries that the Old Gods will be restored echo off the old stones. Somewhere in the water lies the ruins' fathom stone.

parts.body: Inside the fathom stone is a fathom core, a device that relates a history of all elemental activity. The Earthen Ring hopes it will show what the cult is doing to the elements here.

parts.body: Disturbing the stone raises Baron Aquanis, a water elemental long thought a corrupted power. The globe that fed him should prove who corrupted him, and how.

title: Twilight Lord Kelris
body: Twilight Lord Kelris, an orc, leads the Twilight's Hammer in Blackfathom Deeps. He sits in meditation in the Moonshrine Sanctum, channeling dark power among the four Fires of Aku'mai, and beyond them a massive portal holds shut the way deeper into the temple. Every cultist who cries that Aku'mai demands sacrifices answers to him, and he sacrifices innocents to the beast for power.

parts.body: The Argent Dawn had hunted him for years and thought him dead or missing. Wherever evil showed itself in these parts, it says, Kelris had a hand in it.

title: Aku'mai
body: Aku'mai is a hydra of terrible size, the beast the Twilight's Hammer reveres. Legend calls it a favored pet of the Old Gods. The Argent Dawn tells how it came: the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the temple's moonwell, and Aku'mai rose from the waters. It has preyed on the place ever since, and its lair lies beyond the portal the cult guards.

parts.body: A dwarf of Khaz Modan waited by the altar in its lair. Morridune had followed the Twilight's Hammer here to draw power from the beast, until the sacrifice of countless innocents brought him to his senses.
